# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs from server/tools.js. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs`. -->

Pagewright exposes 25 MCP tools. Every tool that acts on a page accepts an optional `tabId`; without it, the tool uses the tab the agent last opened or selected, otherwise the active tab.

Elements are targeted with a `ref` from `browser_snapshot` (preferred) or a `selector`: CSS, `text=Visible text`, `text="Exact text"` or `xpath=//path`. Selectors also search open shadow DOM.

- [Status, tabs and navigation](#status-tabs-and-navigation)
- [Seeing the page](#seeing-the-page)
- [Interacting](#interacting)
- [Frontend debugging](#frontend-debugging)
- [Scraping](#scraping)

## Status, tabs and navigation

### `browser_status`

Check whether the browser extension is connected and which mode this server runs in (hub or relaying through another agent's hub).

No parameters.

### `browser_tabs`

List, open, select (focus) or close browser tabs. "new" opens a tab (optionally at url) and makes it the agent's current tab; "select" makes a tab current.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | `list` \| `new` \| `select` \| `close` \| `current` |  Default: `"list"`. |
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `url` | string | For action "new": page to open. |
| `background` | boolean | For "new"/"select": do not focus the tab. |

### `browser_navigate`

Open a URL in the current tab and wait for it to load, or go back/forward/reload. Returns final URL, title and HTTP status.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | URL to open (scheme optional). |
| `action` | `back` \| `forward` \| `reload` |  |
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `timeout` | integer | Max ms to wait for load (default 30000). |

## Seeing the page

### `browser_snapshot`

Read the page as a compact accessibility-style tree: headings, text, and every interactive element with a [ref=eN] you can pass to click/type/inspect. Use this first to understand a page and find elements — it is cheaper and more precise than a screenshot.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `selector` | string | Only snapshot this subtree. |
| `interactiveOnly` | boolean | Only list interactive elements (smaller output). |
| `maxChars` | integer | Output budget (default 25000). |

### `browser_screenshot`

Capture what the page looks like: the viewport (default), the full scrollable page, or one element (ref/selector). Use it to check visual layout, spacing, alignment, and the result of CSS changes.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `fullPage` | boolean |  |
| `format` | `png` \| `jpeg` \| `webp` | Default png; jpeg is much smaller for long pages. |
| `quality` | integer | jpeg/webp quality (default 80). |
| `scale` | `css` \| `device` | "css" (default) = 1 image px per CSS px; "device" = full retina resolution. |
| `maxHeight` | integer | Cap full-page height in CSS px (default 12000). |
| `savePath` | string | Also save the image to this file path. |

### `browser_get_content`

Get page content for reading or scraping: "markdown" (clean readable text with links), "text", "html", "links" (all links), "tables" (every <table> as JSON rows), or "meta" (title, description, OpenGraph, JSON-LD, headings).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `format` | `markdown` \| `text` \| `html` \| `links` \| `tables` \| `meta` |  Default: `"markdown"`. |
| `selector` | string | Limit to this element. |
| `mainOnly` | boolean | Use <main>/<article> only, skipping nav and footer. |
| `maxChars` | integer | Default 60000. |
| `savePath` | string | Save the content to a file instead of returning all of it. |

## Interacting

### `browser_click`

Click an element with a real mouse event (scrolls it into view first). Target by ref (from browser_snapshot), selector, or x/y viewport coordinates. Reports navigation and any new tabs the click opened. Fails with an explanation if another element (e.g. a modal) covers the target.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `x` | number |  |
| `y` | number |  |
| `button` | `left` \| `right` \| `middle` |  |
| `doubleClick` | boolean |  |
| `force` | boolean | Click via element.click() even if covered/hidden. |

### `browser_hover`

Move the mouse over an element (to open hover menus or tooltips, or check :hover styles).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `x` | number |  |
| `y` | number |  |

### `browser_type`

Type text into an input, textarea or contenteditable. Replaces the current value by default (clear:false to append). Works with React/Vue controlled inputs. submit:true presses Enter afterwards.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `text` (required) | string |  |
| `clear` | boolean |  Default: `true`. |
| `submit` | boolean |  |
| `slowly` | boolean | Type one character at a time (for autocomplete widgets). |

### `browser_press_key`

Press keys on the focused element: "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "ArrowDown", "Control+A", "Meta+Shift+K". Space-separate to press several in order.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `key` (required) | string |  |

### `browser_select_option`

Choose option(s) in a native <select> by value or visible label.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `values` (required) | string[] |  |

### `browser_scroll`

Scroll the page or a scrollable element: by deltaY/deltaX pixels (real wheel events, triggers lazy loading), to "top"/"bottom", or scroll an element into view (ref/selector only).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `deltaX` | number |  |
| `deltaY` | number |  |
| `to` | `top` \| `bottom` \| `left` \| `right` |  |

### `browser_wait_for`

Wait until a selector appears (or disappears with gone:true), text appears, or textGone disappears; or just wait `time` ms.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `selector` | string |  |
| `text` | string |  |
| `textGone` | string |  |
| `gone` | boolean |  |
| `time` | integer | Fixed wait in ms (max 60000). |
| `timeout` | integer | Default 10000 ms. |

### `browser_upload_file`

Set local files on an <input type=file>.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `paths` (required) | string[] | Absolute file paths. |

### `browser_handle_dialogs`

Set how alert/confirm/prompt dialogs are answered on a tab (they are auto-accepted by default and logged to browser_console).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `accept` | boolean |  |
| `promptText` | string |  |

### `browser_evaluate`

Run JavaScript in the page and return the JSON result. Supports top-level await. Example: "document.querySelectorAll('a').length". Not available when the extension was installed from the Chrome Web Store (browser_status shows evaluateAvailable); prefer the other tools.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `expression` (required) | string |  |

## Frontend debugging

### `browser_audit_layout`

Scan the page for visual and layout bugs: horizontal overflow and the elements causing it, content sticking out of its container, clipped text, elements covered by others, broken/stretched/oversized images, low color contrast, tiny text and tap targets, unlabeled controls, plus console errors and failed requests. Each issue has a ref for browser_inspect/browser_screenshot. Run it at several viewports (browser_set_viewport).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `maxPerType` | integer | Default 8. |

### `browser_inspect`

Explain an element's layout: box size and position, margin/border/padding, key computed styles, overflow, parent, and the CSS rules that style it with their source file and line — use it to find which rule to change when fixing the frontend.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `ref` | string | Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector. |
| `selector` | string | CSS selector, "text=Sign in" (visible text), or "xpath=//button". Searches open shadow roots too. |
| `properties` | string[] | Extra computed CSS properties to report. |
| `matchedRules` | boolean | Include matching CSS rules with source locations. Default: `true`. |

### `browser_set_viewport`

Emulate a screen size to test responsive layouts: preset "mobile" (390x844), "mobile-small" (360x640), "tablet" (820x1180), "laptop" (1366x768), "desktop" (1440x900), "desktop-hd" (1920x1080), or custom width/height. reset:true restores the real window.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `preset` | `mobile` \| `mobile-small` \| `tablet` \| `laptop` \| `desktop` \| `desktop-hd` |  |
| `width` | integer |  |
| `height` | integer |  |
| `deviceScaleFactor` | number |  |
| `mobile` | boolean |  |
| `reset` | boolean |  |

### `browser_inject_css`

Live-test a CSS fix on the page without editing files: inject CSS (replaces the previous CSS with the same id), then screenshot/audit to verify. remove:true removes it. Once it looks right, apply the same change to the source code. Lost on reload.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `css` | string |  |
| `id` | string | Name of this style block (default "default"). |
| `append` | boolean |  |
| `remove` | boolean |  |

### `browser_console`

Read console messages, uncaught errors, browser warnings (CSP, mixed content, failed loads) and auto-handled dialogs for the current page.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `level` | `debug` \| `log` \| `warn` \| `error` | Minimum level. |
| `search` | string |  |
| `currentPageOnly` | boolean | Only messages since the last navigation (default: recent history across pages, separated by NAV lines). |
| `limit` | integer | Default 100 (most recent). |
| `clear` | boolean |  |

### `browser_network`

List network requests made by the current page (method, status, type, size, timing). Filter by URL substring, type ("xhr,fetch", "document", "script", "image"…), or failedOnly. Great for finding the JSON API behind a page when scraping — then read it with browser_network_body.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `filter` | string |  |
| `type` | string |  |
| `failedOnly` | boolean |  |
| `includePrevious` | boolean | Include requests from pages before the last navigation. |
| `limit` | integer | Default 100 (most recent). |
| `clear` | boolean |  |

### `browser_network_body`

Get the response body of a request listed by browser_network (e.g. an API's JSON). Optionally save it to a file.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `requestId` (required) | string |  |
| `maxChars` | integer |  |
| `savePath` | string |  |

## Scraping

### `browser_extract`

Extract structured data from the current page. Give itemSelector (one element per record, e.g. ".product") and fields relative to each item, e.g. {"name": "h2", "price": {"selector": ".price", "type": "number"}, "url": "a@href", "image": "img@src"}. Without itemSelector, fields are read once from the whole page.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `itemSelector` | string |  |
| `fields` (required) | object | Map of output field -> spec. Spec is a CSS selector string relative to each item ("h2", "a.title@href" to read an attribute, "." for the item itself) or an object {selector, attr: "text"\|"html"\|"href"\|"src"\|"value"\|<attribute>, all: bool (return every match as an array), type: "number", regex: "capture (group)"}. |
| `limit` | integer | Max items (default 1000). |
| `savePath` | string | Save results as .json or .csv. |

### `browser_scrape`

Scrape many records across pages in one call: optionally open url, extract items with itemSelector+fields, then follow pagination by clicking nextSelector (up to maxPages) and/or scroll to load more (infiniteScroll = number of scrolls). Deduplicates, and saves to .json/.csv with savePath. Uses your real logged-in browser session, so it works on sites that need login or run heavy JavaScript.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tabId` | integer | Tab to act on. Defaults to the tab last opened/selected by an agent, else the active tab. |
| `url` | string |  |
| `itemSelector` (required) | string |  |
| `fields` (required) | object | Map of output field -> spec. Spec is a CSS selector string relative to each item ("h2", "a.title@href" to read an attribute, "." for the item itself) or an object {selector, attr: "text"\|"html"\|"href"\|"src"\|"value"\|<attribute>, all: bool (return every match as an array), type: "number", regex: "capture (group)"}. |
| `nextSelector` | string | Selector of the "next page" link/button. |
| `maxPages` | integer |  Default: `1`. |
| `infiniteScroll` | integer | Scroll to bottom this many times per page, extracting after each. |
| `delayMs` | integer | Pause after each page/scroll (default 1200). Be polite to servers. |
| `limit` | integer | Stop after this many items. |
| `savePath` | string |  |
